name: serpapi_maps_search
description: Search places and local business results through SerpApi Google Maps with normalized place fields like address, rating, hours, phone, and website.

query.description: Place or local search query. Example: coffee shops in Austin.

ll.description: Optional lat/lng bias for Google Maps. Example: @30.2672,-97.7431,14z

hl.description: Language code for Google Maps results (default: en).

device.description: desktop, mobile, or tablet. Default: desktop.

num_results.description: How many normalized results to return (1-10, default: 5).

no_cache.description: If true, bypass SerpApi cache for fresh fetch.

extra_params.description: Additional engine-specific query parameters passed through to SerpApi.

include_raw.description: If true, include full raw SerpApi payload in data.raw.
